comments.body: 2026-10-24: a second typing test failed the same way in the gate at aa2ec3fc: typing::a_click_is_reported_only_to_a_program_tracking_the_mouse_and_never_with_shift, its tracking file empty after 20 s; passed 3 of 3 alone. Being looked at against c784999a.
comments.author: Alexander Terp

comments.body: 2026-10-24 investigation: c784999a is ruled out, by code (neither failing test reaches the mark; the nudge is a non-blocking pipe write) and by experiment: typing:: looped with --test-threads 8, three copies at once, 40 runs each - 3/120 and 1/120 as is, 4/120 with c784999a's calls disabled. Eight failures across seven of the module's eighteen tests, all the same: the program reading the pane sees nothing for 20 s. Pattern in five kept daemon logs: the starved pane is always the last one the test made; the harness's input opens 0-5 ms after the read that found that pane's 'ready', so the input lands well under 100 ms after ready, while earlier panes get theirs hundreds of ms later; the program's output file exists and is empty; the log has no warning, restart or flush. The daemon drops typed input only on a restart's flush (Discards::is_stale, pty::flush_input from restart.rs). Leads: (1) a debug line per successful write (pane, seq, byte count, no text) would say whether the bytes left the daemon; (2) what runs between 'echo ready' and the program's first read - a tcsetattr with TCSAFLUSH or a tcflush there (stty, the shell, Ghostty's shell integration) discards pending input, which would fit exactly; (3) pty::queued briefly opens the slave side from the reader. Starvation unlikely: it always hits the pane sent input soonest after ready.

description: Seen once 2026-10-24 in a full ./dev on main (8042bdfb) on the Mac mini at load ~14: the raw reader's file held "" after 20 s, so not even the second send's 'after' arrived. Passed 2 of 2 alone. The test is old (cf222f95), but the writer changed today: c784999a marks a keyed Return or Esc before writing it and nudges the reader, and this test's first send has enter: true with an unknown key. Check that path for a stall under contention before reading it as starvation.
title: 🎲 Input sent to a pane just after it prints ready is sometimes never read (typing tests, ~3% under load)
